_comment: Central configuration for the EV Charging Load Balancer. Every script and the Flink job read their settings from here, so an experiment is changed in ONE place.

dataset._replay_note: Two busiest pre-COVID weeks in the data (week of 13 Jan 2020 had the most sessions of 2019-2020).

feeders._note: Palo Alto does not publish its distribution grid layout. Car parks are grouped into feeders by geographic area (ASSUMPTION, stated in the report).

capacity._note: EV hosting capacity of each feeder = installed charger capacity x diversity factor. A diversity factor < 1 reflects that not every charger draws full power at the same time; planners use it to size shared supply.

power_model._note: While a car is charging its charger reports power every sample_interval_s seconds; energy is spread evenly over the real charging time from the dataset.

pipeline._note: Defaults for the Flink job; every value can be overridden on the command line for experiments.

tariff._note: ILLUSTRATIVE time-of-use tariff (assumption): three daily periods with the evening 16:00-21:00 peak typical of California commercial EV rates. The dataset itself has no price changes.

generator._note: Network / device behaviour applied to the clean event stream. Delays are in EVENT-TIME units (how much later an event arrives than it happened).
